Definition: , and ταύτην, and ταύτης dative case, accusative case and genitive case respectively of the feminine singular of G3778; (towards or of) this:--her, + hereof, it, that, + thereby, the (same), this (same).
BiblicalUsage: The word is this, the feminine singular of this, in its cases. Jesus asks, Whereunto shall I liken this generation; He says, All ye shall be offended because of me this night; and He turns to the woman and says to Simon, Seest thou this woman.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the word that brings the matter close: this generation, this night, this woman.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
